method: Read-only audit of 13 current integration test builders and the exact claims in their bodies. Checked effective EC3 source for binary header, PDF 2 trailer ID, page Resources, embedded-file table rows and PDF-version AP scope. No Cargo or tests run. Fixture defects below qualify regression evidence; they do not by themselves establish a product failure.

source_locations.rule: If the PDF contains binary data, the header line shall be immediately followed by a comment line containing at least four bytes whose values are 128 or greater.

source_locations.title: Entries in the file trailer dictionary
source_locations.rule: ID is required in PDF2.0+; it is an array of two byte strings each at least 16 bytes. §14.4 requires both IDs be set to the same value when the file is first written.
When first written, both ID byte strings shall be set to the same value; the first is permanent and the second may change on update.

source_locations.title: Entries in a page object
source_locations.rule: Resources is required and inheritable. A page needing no resources uses an empty dictionary; omission relies on an ancestor resource dictionary.

source_locations.title: Entries in a file specification dictionary
source_locations.rule: F required absent DOS/Mac/Unix; reader uses present UF instead of F; EF requires corresponding F/UF keys and an indirect Type Filespec; Desc shall be used for specs in EmbeddedFiles; CI, if present, is an indirect reference.

source_locations.title: Entries in an interactive form dictionary
source_locations.rule: The AP/NeedAppearances note varies by PDF version; the tested no-AP case is PDF1.7 with NeedAppearances true. PDF2.0's general AP requirements are not retroactively imposed on that fixture.

files_reviewed.claim: Valid exact-xref PDF2 collection/CI/CompressedSize public regression.
issues: The earlier exact-xref fixture lacked PDF2 ID/header marker, FileSpec F, and indirect CI; parent has corrected the current test file with those source requirements, retained existing Desc, used UTF-16BE UF, and added a complete-chain guard.

Parent reports all four B05/B06 assertions still fail after the fixture repair, with literal population/description/size controls passing. This is an externally reported current result, not a run by this shard.
Filename is not a separate F-fallback control because F and UF display the same text.

files_reviewed.claim: Direct-vs-indirect FileSpec and embedded-parameter equivalence in PDF2.
issues: Both direct and indirect FileSpecs are referenced from the EmbeddedFiles name tree, so Table43 Desc shall be used.
PDF2 trailer has no /ID; payloads and fixture bytes are ASCII, so no binary marker is implicated.

Each FileSpec has F and matching EF/F; direct and indirect UF values should be valid UTF-16BE text strings. The scratch copy retains legacy F, uses UTF-16BE UF in both paths, and asserts decoded file_name and literal Desc values.
No reader rejection is inferred from these producer-side requirements.

files_reviewed.claim: PDF2 depth-64/65 page-tree order consumer regression.
issues: Trailer lacks required ID.
Generated bodies, streams, and xref are ASCII, so §7.5.2 binary-marker rule is not triggered.
Leaf pages supply Resources; tree parents/count/order appear coherent. Add two 16-byte IDs before treating the source as a valid PDF2 witness.

files_reviewed.claim: Direct/indirect stream filter and DecodeParms equivalence with literal decoded rows.
issues: The single Page object and its Pages ancestor omit Resources; Table31 requires the inheritable Resources entry.
The first test's Flate-only stream contains binary deflate bytes without the §7.5.2 marker. The ASCII85-wrapped second case is ASCII, but uses the same builder with missing page Resources.
PDF1.7 needs no trailer ID. Add /Resources << >> to the Page and a binary marker to the fixture header; literal decoded rows remain independent.

files_reviewed.claim: Checksum computed over decoded 19-byte payload, not 27-byte Flate bytes.
issues: PDF1.7 makes trailer ID optional, and Page Resources, F/UF/Desc, EF F/UF, Type, subtype and parameter size/checksum are present.
The fixed zlib stream contains binary bytes but header has no binary comment. Add it before counting the fixture as conforming; the positive/negative checksum controls are otherwise independent.

files_reviewed.claim: CIDToGIDMap big-endian bytes and missing-CID fallback with embedded TrueType outlines.
issues: PDF1.7 makes ID optional; Page Resources and font references are present.
Both embedded TTF and CID map contain binary data; the PDF header is not followed by the required binary comment.
Numeric CID/GID assertions and glyph-outline controls are distinct; preserve current font-metric validity work while repairing the header.

files_reviewed.claim: Invalid nonnumeric Decode item must not be silently filtered; valid six-number positive control rendered literal red.
issues: The parent has added a binary header marker and chain guard since the inspected version; source-framing defect is corrected in the current file.
Page Resources/XObject references are coherent; no ID is required in PDF1.7.
The null Decode target remains intentionally malformed as the feature under test; this audit did not execute it.

files_reviewed.claim: Valid PDF1.7 save/reopen probes for NeedAppearances true with one no-AP widget and false with AP on all visible widgets.
issues: ASCII-only PDF1.7; no ID or binary marker needed.
Resources are inherited from /Pages; form DA/DR Helv resolves to Type1 font object 8; both widgets are linked in page Annots and field Kids with reciprocal Parent and valid P.
No-AP widget case sets NeedAppearances true; fully-AP control sets false, as scoped by Table224's version condition. This is not a blanket PDF2 AP certification.

files_reviewed.claim: PDF1.7 public ScriptRunner boundary distinguishes ancestor-only vs terminal-local field AA/K.
issues: ASCII-only PDF1.7; no ID/header marker needed. Resources are inherited from an empty Pages resource dictionary.
Terminal text field is a child of nonterminal field, and widget is a child of terminal field, in page Annots with matching /P and reciprocal /Parent. DA/DR points to Type1 font object 7.
No AP is paired with NeedAppearances true. Runner is an explicit test seam; this does not certify a JavaScript engine.

files_reviewed.claim: PDF1.7 public Query layers across two visible pages, with independent accessibility proof of layout.
issues: ASCII-only content streams; no ID/binary marker required.
Each page has valid Resources/Properties, Contents and two page-tree links; OCGs are catalog-listed and names/order exist.
File checks exact xref and test independently requires two visible pages before comparing layers.

files_reviewed.claim: Missing page-label S uses only prefix; absent/empty P yields empty labels with literal controls.
issues: ASCII-only PDF1.7; no ID/header marker required.
Page Resources is inherited from Pages; four page refs and label Nums ranges are coherent.
The absent S target is the intentional feature condition, not missing whole page structure.

files_reviewed.claim: Valid PDF1.7 multi-level name tree destination lookup by exact byte keys.
issues: ASCII-only PDF1.7; no ID/header marker required. Both Pages have Resources.
Indirect Kids/Limits and sorted keys A/a, b/z align with child ranges; each destination points to an existing page.
Exact xref assertion is present.

files_reviewed.claim: PDF1.7 local/public Reference boundary with nearby, late-label, numeric-page, and color controls.
issues: Target PDF1.7 does include a 16-byte ID pair, but its initial values differ, contrary to §14.4 first-write equality; the Reference's /ID uses that same unequal pair. Make both target IDs and corresponding Ref IDs equal while preserving the identity-match control.
Outer and target bytes are ASCII; no binary marker is indicated. Page Resources and the target ID existence are tested.

limits: Thirteen current test files were sampled; this is not a suite-wide fixture certification.
The direct source defects are producer/file-conformance issues; they do not establish that a reader must reject those inputs.
No tests were executed and no result was promoted. Corrected fixture copies are ready for parent-side promotion/execution.
The intentionally malformed Decode element is preserved; only unrelated file framing is repaired.

For PDF2 test fixtures, generated first-write ID strings in drafts are identical and at least 16 bytes. For the PDF1.7 Reference target, ID is optional but the included initial pair is made equal per §14.4.
parent_execution: Six additional corrected files integrated. Wave109:10 tests,6PASS,4 known failures B32/B48/B54.
